paragraphs.text: Unperceived mind-stuff grounds no purpose: if no spirit sees it, it is for nothing. Try to escape by saying will belongs to nature-in-general, and the escape explodes — every soul would have to be omniscient. Perceived-by-all mixes every appearance together, unless some One holds them all apart — and that One is the turn toward the Lord.

The other side tries nature alone: seeds need no purpose to sprout, purpose-talk is just courtesy-speech. But then the root-cause would churn out effects forever and never stop — so nothing would ever be released, and there could be no liberation without a perceiving maker.
